updates.content:
Title: Users are unable to create or edit new meeting or broadcast events in Microsoft Viva Engage

User impact: Users are unable to create or edit new meeting or broadcast events in Viva Engage.

More info: Users in Europe and the United States are unable to create or edit new meeting or broadcast events in Viva Engage. Existing events and meetings remain accessible and aren't impacted. To bypass this issue, affected users can create the meeting or town hall directly in Microsoft Teams and share the link in Viva Engage.

Current status: We’ve received reports from affected users that users are unable to create or edit new meeting or broadcast events in Viva Engage. We’ve developed a configuration fix and are deploying it to the affected environments to mitigate the impact while we continue investigating the underlying cause. Based on our current estimates, we suspect that the configuration fix will complete deployment by our next scheduled update.

Scope of impact: Impact may occur for all users in Europe and the United States when users attempt to create or edit new meeting or broadcast events in Viva Engage. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Wednesday, October 7, 2026, at 2:00 AM UTC
